name: vaifoou-construction-patterns
description: Inventory of reusable widgets. Restyle these after brand.ts and atoms; do not fork per page.

atoms.name: Button
atoms.shape: Single button atom with variant + tone props

props.tone: dark (default) | light  — only applies when variant=ghost

atoms.notes: Style Guide 110:2377 button = Norca-Rough 14px. primary = square hibiscus fill, cream type. ghost tone=dark = 2px cream outline on photos. ghost tone=light = 2px cacao outline on cream.

atoms.name: Heading
atoms.shape: All heading levels and the eyebrow label — one component
atoms.notes: Style Guide 110:2377: h1=72 / h2=52 / h3=26 Norca-Rough. h4=24px Norca (extra). tag/eyebrow=16px Wreck Script. color=white is text/contrast cream.

atoms.name: Card
atoms.shape: Card shell with optional coloured header band and configurable shadow

props.variant: bordered (default) | pillar | schedule | testimonial | feature | dark | outlined | podcast
props.label: optional header band eyebrow text
props.labelBg: CSS class for header bg — e.g. bg-card-mist | bg-cta-pink
props.labelTextColor: CSS class for header text — e.g. text-secondary | text-cta-pink
props.class: override shadow utility: shadow-card (default) | shadow-card-mist | shadow-card-pink
props.tone: light (default) | dark — only applies when variant=podcast

atoms.notes: Shell only for bordered/pillar/dark/outlined — body in the default slot. variant='feature' also accepts title, description, cta, iconType, featured, and speaker (session body: people row + CTA bottom-right, Figma 64:1201). variant='podcast' is the episode card (Figma 121:916 / 121:1286): cream bg-page, tan tag, dark type, two grey listen placeholders, ghost-light CTA. Same card on tan and page sections.

atoms.name: Text
atoms.shape: All body and UI text — one component
atoms.notes: Style Guide 110:2377: body-lg=16 / body=14 / small=12 Host Grotesk, tracking -1%. button=14px Norca-Rough. color=white is text/contrast cream. Default color is muted (cacao); color=default is text/default cacao-brown.

patterns.name: Hero
patterns.shape: h1 + paragraphs + optional CTA + optional side image + optional badges
patterns.notes: Overlay (Homepage 59:1341): 760px full-bleed, grey placeholder until the photo is ready, left-to-right black/60 gradient, 64px pad, left column max-w 604 (eyebrow → h1 → body-lg → CTAs). Words/page/title variants unchanged. Do not embed Header in the home hero — PageLayout chrome sits above.

patterns.name: Intro + columns
patterns.shape: h2 + intro + 2–4 item columns, no image

patterns.name: Split content + image
patterns.shape: h2 + paragraphs + side image + optional CTA
patterns.notes: Image side comes from the Figma frame.

patterns.name: Heading + CTA row
patterns.shape: h2 sharing a row with a button

patterns.name: Linked service cards
patterns.shape: 2, 3, 4, or 6 cards with per-card links
patterns.notes: Pin CTA with flex-col h-full + mt-auto.

patterns.name: Icon-point band
patterns.shape: 3 or 5 unlinked icon + title + desc, one row

patterns.name: Compact info cards
patterns.shape: 4 compact info cards, one row

patterns.name: Process / timeline
patterns.shape: h2 + ordered steps + optional image

patterns.name: Gallery / projects
patterns.shape: grid of project cards

patterns.name: FAQ accordion
patterns.shape: list of Q&A pairs, no cards

patterns.name: Testimonials
patterns.shape: quotes with name and role

patterns.name: Final CTA banner
patterns.shape: page-ending conversion card
patterns.notes: Use when Figma shows a standalone CTA band. Homepage footer (2:1508) already includes the tan assessment card — do not stack this above Footer.

patterns.name: How Aging Works (Buckets)
patterns.shape: 2-col: left eyebrow+h2+body+dashed line+h3 pullquote / right 3 numbered bucket cards + body copy + CTA
patterns.notes: Figma node 2:83. Bucket card data is baked into the widget. Uses Card variant='bordered' + shadow-card | shadow-card-mist | shadow-card-pink per bucket priority. id='how-aging-works' (matches hero nav anchor).

patterns.name: Site footer
patterns.shape: footer band with logo, link columns, social links, legal links, and copyright
patterns.notes: Shared footer chrome. Do not fork a HomeFooter.

patterns.name: Full-width editorial
patterns.shape: h2 + multiple paragraphs, no image or columns
patterns.notes: Do not use for heading + para + CTA — that is P-03.

patterns.name: Icon-point text grid
patterns.shape: 4 unlinked icon + title + desc, 2 × 2 text, no cards

patterns.name: Blog cards
patterns.shape: article cards in a wrapping grid

patterns.name: Blog article
patterns.shape: sidebar + sequential article body

patterns.name: Gradient Card Split
patterns.shape: 2-col inside gradient card (rounded-tl/tr-[64px]): left eyebrow+h2+body slot+CTA / right image slot (grey placeholder until asset ready)

props.heading: plain-text h2 (use headingHtml for accent spans)
props.headingHtml: HTML string — takes precedence over heading
props.cta: { text, href } optional primary CTA button

slots.image: image or placeholder div — defaults to bg-section-grey grey box

patterns.notes: Figma node 2:229. bg-gradient-to-t from-transparent to-section-grey. Reuse for any section with this gradient card treatment. Content always passed from the page file.

patterns.name: Text Split
figmaNames: Half of this is not your problem.
Then talk to your doctor about it.
patterns.shape: 2-col split: text-only (heading | body); withImage end (text stack | image); withImage under-heading (heading+image | body). rx 32.

props.heading: plain-text h2
props.headingHtml: HTML string — takes precedence (use for accent spans)
props.imageAspect: CSS aspect-ratio for the default placeholder (Figma frame size)
props.imagePlacement: end (default, image opposite text) or under-heading (Figma 62:53)

slots.default: body copy — right column, or under the heading when imagePlacement=end
slots.image: image or placeholder — defaults to bg-section-grey grey box at imageAspect

patterns.notes: Figma 2:271 (portrait, end), 2:1297 (landscape, end), 62:53 (under-heading). Omit withImage for 50/50 text-only splits. Content always passed from the page file.

patterns.name: Chapters List
patterns.shape: Full-rounded card (rounded-[64px]) with photo bg (placeholder), eyebrow, glassmorphism location rows, footer note

props.footerLink: { text, href } — bold underlined link appended to footerNote

patterns.notes: Figma node 2:323. Each row: backdrop-blur glass pill, heading-size location name, members badge (bg-primary), arrow-circle icon. Background photo is a grey placeholder (bg-section-grey) until the image asset is provided.

patterns.name: Pillar Section
patterns.shape: bg-cta tan bg, rounded-tl/tr-[64px] top corners only. 2-col header (eyebrow+h2 | body text). 4-col grid of Card variant=pillar.

props.heading: h2 section heading
props.bodyHtml: right-column body text, supports <strong> for bold span
props.cards: PillarCardItem[] — { label, heading, description, iconSvg, iconBg? }

patterns.notes: Figma node 2:316. Uses Card variant='pillar' (A-05). Each card: label eyebrow top-left, 50×50 icon top-right, heading (28px Fraunces text-primary), description (12px sans text-default). Movement/Food icons carry own tan bg in SVG (iconBg=false). Sleep/Connection are small icons needing the bg-cta rounded-bl container (iconBg=true).

patterns.name: Schedule Section
figmaNames: Information is not an adherence mechanism
patterns.shape: bg-page section, 2-col header (eyebrow+h2 | body), 7-col grid of Card variant=schedule.
patterns.notes: Figma node 2:431. Uses Card variant='schedule' (A-05). Each card: bg-card-light header band with calendar icon + day label (text-secondary). Events: time row (icon + time, opacity-40) + event name. shadow-mist-offset (flat 3px offset, no blur). icon='morning' = sun SVG, icon='evening' = moon/cloud SVG.

patterns.name: Testimonials Carousel
patterns.shape: Dark navy→teal gradient bg. Centered header (eyebrow + h2 with optional inline span). Horizontal Swiper free-mode of Card variant=testimonial (512px each). CSS mask fade on edges.

props.headingHtml: h2 HTML — supports <span class='text-secondary'> for accent words
props.heading: plain-text h2 fallback

patterns.notes: Figma node 2:1375. Uses Card variant='feature' (A-05). Left col: eyebrow+h2 header + stacked compact cards (ghost CTA). Right col: tall featured card (grey image placeholder + solid primary CTA). bg-feature-card (#F1F5F8) + border-card-border-light + rounded-[16px]. iconType='calendar' renders 40×40 bg-card-light tile + 14px calendar icon; iconType='book' renders 40×40 SVG with built-in tile bg.

patterns.name: Written Work Section
patterns.shape: bg-page section. 2-col gap-8: left=header+stacked compact feature cards, right=tall featured card with image placeholder.

props.heading: h2 section heading
props.cards: FeatureCardItem[] for left column stacked compact cards
props.featuredCard: FeatureCardItem for right column tall featured card

patterns.notes: Figma node 2:1375. Uses Card variant='feature' (A-05). Left col: eyebrow+h2 header + stacked compact cards (ghost CTA). Right col: tall featured card (grey image placeholder + solid primary CTA). bg-feature-card (#F1F5F8) + border-card-border-light + rounded-[16px]. iconType='calendar' renders 40×40 bg-card-light tile + 14px calendar icon; iconType='book' renders 40×40 SVG with built-in tile bg.

patterns.name: Testimonials Carousel (moved from P-24)
patterns.notes: Figma node 2:1305. Uses Card variant='testimonial' (A-05): quote mark SVG (mix-blend-overlay), Fraunces italic 22px quote, small uppercase attribution. Swiper v14 FreeMode, slidesPerView='auto', slidesOffsetBefore/After=80px. Edge fade via CSS mask-image gradient.

patterns.name: Concept Split
patterns.shape: bg-page section. TOP 2-col (28px heading | body+CTA, gap 64px). BOTTOM 2-col (2×2 pillar cards | image, gap 32px).

props.heading: left-column 28px Fraunces heading
props.cta: { text, href } optional primary CTA under the body

slots.image: image or grey placeholder — defaults to bg-section-grey, aspect 1695/928, rounded-[32px]

patterns.notes: Figma nodes 62:71 (frame), 62:553 (intro), 62:77 (cards + image). Uses Card variant='pillar' (A-05) without icons. Content always passed from the page file.

patterns.name: Concept Cards
patterns.shape: bg-page section. 4-col row of Card variant=pillar (label + 28px title + 12px body), gap 32px, no header, no icons, no image.
patterns.notes: Figma node 64:845 (Four Pillars). Same Card variant='pillar' as ConceptSplit, laid out as a full-width 4-up row with no intro or image. Content always passed from the page file.

patterns.name: Duo Cards
patterns.shape: 2 equal promo cards, gap 32px. dark = navy→primary gradient + ghost CTA. outlined = 4px navy border + gradient h2 + primary CTA. rounded-[64px], p-48, CTA pinned mt-auto.

props.cards: DuoCardItem[] — { variant: 'dark' | 'outlined', eyebrow?, heading, body, cta: { text, href } }

patterns.notes: Figma node 64:1086 (Chapters). Uses Card variant='dark' | 'outlined' (A-05) plus Heading, Text, Button. Content always passed from the page file.

patterns.name: Books Grid
patterns.shape: Filter tabs (Textbook / Guidebook / Bargaining / Podcast) + 3×6 book-cover placeholder grid.

props.books: Book[] from Sanity — cover image, slug, series

patterns.notes: Figma node 121:18. Filter tabs are interactive (JS). Covers scroll to #book-{slug} on the same page. Grey placeholder until a cover is uploaded in Studio.

patterns.name: Book Series Feature
patterns.shape: Dark navy→primary gradient. Header row (eyebrow+h2 | description). Glass card: book info+tags+buy buttons (left) | cover placeholder (right). Optional rounded-b-hero.

props.heading: h2 series title
props.book: BookFeatureItem — { subtitle, title, description, tags, buyButtons, publisherNote }
props.roundedBottom: boolean — adds rounded-b-hero (Bargaining with Aging variant)

patterns.notes: Figma nodes 121:246 (Textbook) and 121:532 (Bargaining with Aging). Same component, different props.

patterns.name: GuideBook Grid
patterns.shape: bg-page section. Header (eyebrow+h2 | description). 3-col grid of book cards (cover placeholder + title + subtitle + description + tags + buy buttons).

props.heading: h2 section heading
props.books: GuideBookItem[] — { slug, title, subtitle, description, image, tags, buyButtons, publisherNote, podcastHref }

patterns.notes: Figma node 121:313. Card bg is bg-card-light. Covers come from Sanity; grey placeholder if missing. Card id is book-{slug} for in-page jumps.

patterns.name: Media Appearances
patterns.shape: bg-page section. Centered header (eyebrow+h2+subtitle). Horizontal CSS marquee (same as Testimonials) of appearance cards (italic Fraunces quote + book cover placeholder on right). Optional CTA button.
patterns.notes: Figma node 121:566. Cards duplicated for seamless CSS marquee loop. Pauses on hover. Edge fade mask.

patterns.name: Session Cards
patterns.shape: Optional eyebrow + 2-col grid of Card variant=feature with speaker row. Calendar header, 28px title, people+speaker, 12px body, ghost Explore CTA pinned bottom-right.

props.cards: SessionCardItem[] — { label, title, speaker?, description, ctaText?, ctaHref? }

patterns.notes: Figma node 64:1201 (Guidebooks). Uses Card variant='feature' (A-05) with speaker prop for the session body layout. Content always passed from the page file.

patterns.name: Podcast Filter
patterns.shape: Centered eyebrow+h2+body, then wrapping uppercase filter pills (active = accent fill).
patterns.notes: Figma node 121:1169. Filter tabs are interactive (JS). Content always passed from the page file.

patterns.name: Podcast Episodes
patterns.shape: Centered eyebrow+h2+body, then 3-col grid of Card variant=podcast. tone=light | dark.

props.heading: h2 category title
props.episodes: PodcastEpisodeItem[] — { slug?, title, tag?, description?, ctaText?, ctaHref?, status?, spotifyUrl?, youtubeUrl? }

patterns.notes: Figma node 121:1286 (light, page bg) and 121:916 (dark, tan bg-cta/60). Uses Card variant='podcast' (A-05) — cream card, dark type, same on both tones. Pass one episode while the grid is still a template.

patterns.name: Single Quote
figmaNames: You are only as young as your oldest parts
patterns.shape: bg-page outer. Inner card: gradient from-transparent to-section-grey, rounded-tl/tr-[64px], p-[64px]. Large quote-mark SVG (mix-blend-overlay), h2 Fraunces quote, eyebrow attribution.
patterns.notes: Figma node 121:1715. Not a carousel — one standalone pullquote card.

patterns.name: Credentials Section
patterns.shape: bg-cta (tan), rounded-tl/tr-[64px], p-[120px]. 2-col: left=eyebrow+h2+two credential cards / right=tall residencies timeline card.
patterns.notes: Figma node 121:1861. Uses Card variant='pillar' with iconBg so header icon tiles match homepage (36px mobile / 50px desktop). Residencies card: same chrome, timeline with dashed connector lines.

patterns.name: Publications Section
patterns.shape: bg-page, centered eyebrow+h2 header, 3-col grid of publication cards. Each card: bg-feature-card, border-section-grey, rounded-[16px], book tile icon + count eyebrow + h4 title + small description.
patterns.notes: Figma node 121:2085. Three publication series cards in a row. Book icon is the same tile as Card variant=feature (36px mobile / 40px desktop, bookTileSvg).

patterns.name: Talk to Your Doctor
figmaNames: Talk to your doctor about it
patterns.shape: 2-col: left icon+h3+body rows with muted dividers / right navy→primary packages card overlapping a heading-coloured disclosure tab.

props.clinicEyebrow: uppercase label on the packages card
props.addOnNote: right-aligned muted note under the steps
props.disclosureEyebrow: uppercase label on the overlapping tab

patterns.notes: Figma nodes 176:243 (page hero via Hero2 variant=page) and 176:259 (this widget). Content always passed from the page file.

patterns.name: Brand ticker bar
patterns.shape: Full-bleed seaweed strip. Looping icon + Wreck Script words.

props.items: Array<{ text, tilt? }> — default Healthy / Fresh / Local

patterns.notes: Homepage 66:2. 32px Wreck Script (type-ticker), cream type, 42×42 grey icon placeholders, CSS marquee. Do not fork per page.

patterns.name: Local sourcing
figmaNames: Sourced close to home, on purpose.
patterns.shape: Seaweed band. Inset intro panel (eyebrow+h2 | body-lg+primary CTA) with four overlapping 8px-border fact cards (icon placeholder + h3 + body).
patterns.notes: Homepage 59:106. Transparent section so the page gradient + leaf motif show through. Cream fact cards stay filled. Cards overlap the intro by 42px. Basket icons are grey placeholders until the image pass. Do not fork per page.

patterns.name: Pre-footer conversion band
patterns.shape: Three global CTAs above the footer on every page
patterns.notes: Former pre-footer CTA row. Removed from PageLayout — do not reintroduce per page.
